action_items: None blocking. Note (documentation-level, not a bug): review-request states predator_hunt prestige=+20, but the running backend awards +25 (20 base + 5 spec 'fallback_if_no_cosmetic.prestige' when the deterministic _seeded_cosmetic hash misses). This is per-code and per-spec (backend/app/domain/missions.py:189-194) — the '+20' language in the review-request is only the base value; the fallback bonus is intended. If the main agent wants the review-request literal number to match, either drop the fallback bonus for predator_hunt or clarify the review-request text. Test asserts >=20 to remain robust.
